id.name: ID
id.description: A name other parts refer to. Charts default to c1, c2, …; datasets to d1, d2, …; axes to x1, y1, …; plots to p1, p2, ….

name.name: NAME
name.description: A label people see: a chart's tab name, an axis title, or a plot's legend entry. A plot's name defaults to the column its values come from.

title.name: TITLE
title.description: A heading: above a chart, or, after the outer `]`, above the whole collection.

subtitle.name: SUBTITLE
subtitle.description: A second line under a chart's title.

description.name: DESCRIPTION
description.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Defaults to a summary generated from its plots.

instructions.name: INSTRUCTIONS
instructions.description: Guidance shown under the collection's title.

theme.name: THEME
theme.description: The colour scheme for every chart, LIGHT or DARK. Defaults to LIGHT.

palette.name: PALETTE
palette.description: The colours plots take in order, e.g. palette ["blue-500" "amber-500" "#10b981"]. Tailwind tokens or hex codes.

background.name: BACKGROUND
background.description: The background colour behind every chart.

show-chart-tabs.name: SHOW_CHART_TABS
show-chart-tabs.description: Show a tab per chart. Defaults to true with two or more charts, false with one.

show-chart-menu.name: SHOW_CHART_MENU
show-chart-menu.description: Show the chart menu, which lists every chart. Defaults to false.

dataset-id.name: DATASET_ID
dataset-id.description: Which dataset a chart's column names refer to. May be left out when exactly one dataset is visible.

width.name: WIDTH
width.description: A chart's width, in pixels or as a percentage like "100%". Defaults to "100%".

height.name: HEIGHT
height.description: A chart's height in pixels. Defaults to 384.

animation.name: ANIMATION
animation.description: Animate the chart as it draws. Defaults to true.

columns.name: COLUMNS
columns.description: A dataset's column names, in order, e.g. columns ["month" "revenue"].

rows.name: ROWS
rows.description: A dataset's rows: lists in column order, e.g. rows [["Jan" 120] ["Feb" 132]], records, e.g. rows [{month: "Jan" revenue: 120}], or data fetched and shaped by L0185: rows data use "0185".

direction.name: DIRECTION
direction.description: Which way an axis runs: X (across), Y (up), or RADIAL (the spokes of a radar chart). Required.

scale.name: SCALE
scale.description: An axis's scale: CATEGORY, LINEAR, LOG or TIME. Defaults to CATEGORY when the axis has categories, LINEAR otherwise.

categories.name: CATEGORIES
categories.description: A CATEGORY axis's steps: a list, or the name of a dataset column, e.g. categories "month".

min-value.name: MIN_VALUE
min-value.description: Where a numeric, time or RADIAL axis starts, or the bottom of a GAUGE's dial (default 0). Defaults to fitting the data on an axis, 0 on a RADIAL axis.

max-value.name: MAX_VALUE
max-value.description: Where a numeric, time or RADIAL axis ends, or the top of a GAUGE's dial (default 100). On a RADIAL axis it defaults to a round number above the largest value.

position.name: POSITION
position.description: Where something sits. An X axis: BOTTOM or TOP. A Y axis: LEFT or RIGHT. A legend: TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT or RIGHT. A label: see its plot kind.

inverse.name: INVERSE
inverse.description: Run an axis the other way. Defaults to false.

rotate.name: ROTATE
rotate.description: Rotate an axis's labels by this many degrees, from -90 to 90.

kind.name: KIND
kind.description: What a plot draws: BAR, LINE, PIE, SCATTER, HISTOGRAM, BOXPLOT, CANDLESTICK, HEATMAP, FUNNEL, GAUGE or RADAR. Required.

x-axis.name: X_AXIS
x-axis.description: The id of the X axis a plot is drawn against. May be left out when the chart has one X axis.

y-axis.name: Y_AXIS
y-axis.description: The id of the Y axis a plot is drawn against. May be left out when the chart has one Y axis.

values.name: VALUES
values.description: A plot's values: a list, or the name of a dataset column. One per category for BAR and LINE, one per spoke for RADAR, one per slice for PIE and FUNNEL, raw observations for HISTOGRAM and BOXPLOT, and rows of cells (or one per x/y pair) for HEATMAP.

names.name: NAMES
names.description: A PIE's or FUNNEL's slice names, or a SCATTER's point names: a list, or a column name.

x.name: X
x.description: The x of each point, for SCATTER and x/y LINE, or each cell's X category for a HEATMAP written as x/y/values: a list, or a column name.

y.name: Y
y.description: The y of each point, for SCATTER and x/y LINE, or each cell's Y category for a HEATMAP written as x/y/values: a list, or a column name.

value.name: VALUE
value.description: A GAUGE's reading: one number within its min-value and max-value (0 to 100 by default).

bin-count.name: BIN_COUNT
bin-count.description: How many equal-width bins a HISTOGRAM uses: a whole number above 0. Defaults to Sturges' rule.

group.name: GROUP
group.description: Which category each BOXPLOT value belongs to, one per value: a list, or a column name, e.g. group "class".

open.name: OPEN
open.description: A CANDLESTICK's opening values, one per category: a list, or a column name.

close.name: CLOSE
close.description: A CANDLESTICK's closing values, one per category: a list, or a column name.

low.name: LOW
low.description: A CANDLESTICK's lowest values, one per category: a list, or a column name.

high.name: HIGH
high.description: A CANDLESTICK's highest values, one per category: a list, or a column name.

color.name: COLOR
color.description: A plot's colour: a Tailwind token like "blue-500", or a hex code.

colors.name: COLORS
colors.description: One colour per bar (BAR) or per slice (PIE), in order.

stack.name: STACK
stack.description: Stack BAR or LINE plots that share this group name, e.g. stack "total". Category values only.

smooth.name: SMOOTH
smooth.description: Draw a LINE as a smooth curve.

area.name: AREA
area.description: Fill the area under a LINE, or inside a RADAR plot.

step.name: STEP
step.description: Draw a LINE as steps: START, MIDDLE or END. Not with smooth.

symbol.name: SYMBOL
symbol.description: The marker on a LINE or SCATTER: CIRCLE, RECT, TRIANGLE, DIAMOND, PIN, ARROW, NONE.

bar-width.name: BAR_WIDTH
bar-width.description: A BAR's width, in pixels or as a percentage of its category, e.g. "60%".

inner-radius.name: INNER_RADIUS
inner-radius.description: Makes a PIE a donut with a hole this size, e.g. inner-radius "50%".

radius.name: RADIUS
radius.description: A PIE's outer radius. Defaults to "70%".

rose.name: ROSE
rose.description: Makes a PIE a rose (nightingale) chart: RADIUS or AREA shows the value.

start-angle.name: START_ANGLE
start-angle.description: Where a PIE's first slice starts, in degrees. Defaults to 90 (twelve o'clock).

label.name: LABEL
label.description: Labels on a plot's bars, points or slices, e.g. label show true position TOP formatter "{c}%" {}.

show.name: SHOW
show.description: Whether a label, legend or tooltip shows.

formatter.name: FORMATTER
formatter.description: A label's template: {a} is the plot name, {b} the category or slice name, {c} the value, {d} a PIE slice's percent, e.g. "{b}: {d}%".

trigger.name: TRIGGER
trigger.description: What a tooltip reports: AXIS (everything at a category) or ITEM (one bar, point or slice).

dataset.name: DATASET
dataset.description: A table of data, e.g. dataset id "sales" columns ["month" "revenue"] rows [["Jan" 120]] {}.

axis.name: AXIS
axis.description: One axis, e.g. axis id "month" direction X scale CATEGORY categories "month" {}.

plot.name: PLOT
plot.description: One plot, e.g. plot kind BAR values "revenue" {}.

legend.name: LEGEND
legend.description: A chart's legend, e.g. legend show true position TOP {}.

tooltip.name: TOOLTIP
tooltip.description: A chart's tooltip, e.g. tooltip trigger ITEM {}.

charts.name: CHARTS
charts.description: The program: its datasets and charts, then the collection's settings (title, instructions, theme, palette, …).

chart.name: CHART
chart.description: One chart: its parts (datasets, axes, plots, legend, tooltip), then its settings (id, name, title, …).

CATEGORY.name: TAG
CATEGORY.description: An axis of named steps, e.g. months.

LOG.name: TAG
LOG.description: A logarithmic numeric axis. Every value on it must be above 0.

TIME.name: TAG
TIME.description: A date/time axis. Values are dates like "2026-03-01" or millisecond timestamps.

INSIDE.name: TAG
INSIDE.description: Inside the bar, slice or point.

CENTER.name: TAG
CENTER.description: In the centre of a donut.

BAR.name: TAG
BAR.description: A bar plot: one bar per category.

LINE.name: TAG
LINE.description: A line plot: values over categories, or x/y pairs.

PIE.name: TAG
PIE.description: A pie (or donut, or rose): one slice per name.

SCATTER.name: TAG
SCATTER.description: A scatter plot: one point per x/y pair.

HISTOGRAM.name: TAG
HISTOGRAM.description: A histogram: raw values counted into equal-width bins.

BOXPLOT.name: TAG
BOXPLOT.description: A box plot: quartiles, whiskers and outliers per category.

CANDLESTICK.name: TAG
CANDLESTICK.description: A candlestick: open, close, low and high per category.

HEATMAP.name: TAG
HEATMAP.description: A heatmap: a colour per cell of two category axes.

FUNNEL.name: TAG
FUNNEL.description: A funnel: stages narrowing by value.

GAUGE.name: TAG
GAUGE.description: A gauge: one reading on a dial.

RADAR.name: TAG
RADAR.description: A radar (spider) plot: one value per spoke of a RADIAL axis.

RADIAL.name: TAG
RADIAL.description: The spokes of a radar chart.

START.name: TAG
START.description: A step that rises at the start of each interval.

MIDDLE.name: TAG
MIDDLE.description: A step that rises in the middle of each interval.

END.name: TAG
END.description: A step that rises at the end of each interval.

RADIUS.name: TAG
RADIUS.description: A rose whose slice radius shows the value.

AREA.name: TAG
AREA.description: A rose whose slice area shows the value.

AXIS.name: TAG
AXIS.description: A tooltip for everything at the pointer's category.

ITEM.name: TAG
ITEM.description: A tooltip for the single bar, slice or point under the pointer.
